interfaces.anchored_path: The complete acquired path on h+1 points, for degree at most h+2, and its exact natural symmetric suffix groups are used. The proof determines each individual mark by centralizing the appropriate later symmetric group.
interfaces.local_cut: Both omission sides are the actual full local omission orbits, with their two commuting anchored factors.
interfaces.first_omission: The additional exact point-stabilizer conclusion requires actual intransitivity of the first omission; it is not inferred from a quotient IP.
interfaces.purity: All symmetric groups in the equality theorem are actual permutation groups on W, fixing the displayed complement in W. No purity outside this restricted orbit is asserted.

new_statements: An anchored transitive action of degree at most h+2 and h>=3 has trivial permutation centralizer.
Two nontrivial commuting anchored factors of lengths h,u with h+u>=4 require degree at least h+u+2.
At the minimum local crossing degree with h,u>=2, the two omission factors are pure natural Sym on opposite sides, and the whole action is natural Sym.
If its first omission is intransitive, that omission is exactly the natural symmetric point stabilizer.
